mentions.h: MATCH v. LONDON ATHLETIC CLUB. 5th MAY, 1934.
mentions.note: 1st 1 Mile Unattached Novices; printed surname first
won 880 yards handicap (65); winner of the Novice Mile earlier in the year; young schoolmaster

mentions.h: FINAL CLUB TRACK MEETING ON 1st SEPTEMBER, 1934.
mentions.note: won 1 Mile Club Handicap off 100 yards

mentions.h: CLUB 3 MILES ROAD RUN AND HANDICAP.
MATCH v. EALING HARRIERS AT WIMBLEDON.

mentions.note: ran very much better than the preceding week
won the individual race, led throughout; result: 1, 29 20, team "A"
7 in the seven miles championship (40 41); 11† on handicap; club column 'B'
died 25 April 1936 aged 24; schoolmaster; won South of Thames C.C. Association Junior Championship, November 1935
78, 58 2; Belgrave team won the Dewar Shield and Sir J. Colman Cup

share.d: Evaun Williams in The Belgravian, the Belgrave Harriers club gazette, 1934–1997: 15 mentions in 8 issues and 10 race results.
